fd1_e1_per_configuration.csv.shows: each single configuration as if it were the only one: SUPPORTS on necessary / not-necessary node instances (held-out reliable cases, clear instances)

fd2_e1_confusion_by_case.csv.shows: PRIMARY-standing confusion per held-out case (nodes and IG top-1 selections)

fd3_e1_rq3_reversals.csv.shows: share of node instances with a reversal finding, clear vs ambiguous (descriptive)

fd4_central_primary_supported.csv.shows: PRIMARY-supported samples (IG vs R), alternative reversals and configuration-level disagreement per held-out site, with 95% Wilson intervals

fd5_central_profiles_per_sample.csv.shows: per-sample sensitivity profiles by role (supporting / tested configurations); descriptive, not a score

fd6_e2_concepts.csv.shows: known-positive / known-negative concepts under the frozen concept policy

fd7_esnli.json.shows: plausibility (token F1 vs annotator 1) and faithfulness (audited standings) side by side; never merged

fd9_performance.csv.shows: end-to-end cost per stage (single runs, one machine)
